name: UGC demo · problem then fix
description: One continuous shot where a creator shows the annoying moment, then uses the product and shows the result. Use it when the product is easier to show than to describe.
prompt: One continuous phone-camera shot in a {{ setting }}. {{ creator }} shows the problem: {{ problem }}. Then they use the product and show the result: {{ result }}. Natural daylight, real hands, no cuts, the product label stays readable. They say only: "{{ line }}". No captions, no text on screen.
negative_prompt: cuts, captions, on-screen text, watermark, exaggerated reaction
author: kilnry
